column1: # recent components, computed: only the sources that exist (see lib/components.sh for the table format).
# Files first (nvim, fasd), then directories (zlua, dirs, fasd-dirs, visited); the first file mode is the
# default, else the first directory mode.
[[ -f "$FZX_RECENT_NVIM_DB" ]] && command -v sqlite3 > /dev/null && mode nvim "files opened in nvim (telescope-frecency)"
# shellcheck disable=SC2034  # filled through its name; only success matters here
command -v fasd > /dev/null && { mode fasd-dirs "frecent directories (fasd)"; mode visited "recently visited directories (fasd)"; }
printf 'sort\trank\t-\tthe tool'"'"'s ranking, best first (visited: last visit first)\tdefault\n'
# shellcheck disable=SC2016  # $EDITOR is text in the description
printf 'action\tremove\tctrl-x\tforget the selected entries (fasd, zoxide, z.lua)\tsilent,reload\n'
